sentences.text:
Through: Mr. Harsh Jaidka, Adv  versus  STATE OF DELHI AND ANR. ..
 Through: Mr. Ajay Vikram Singh  State with Insp. Anil  Mr. Manoj Kumar, Adv.
 CORAM:
 HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE JASMEET SINGH  ORDER % 20.02.2023 Exemption allowed, subject to all just exceptions.
This is a petition seeking quashing of FIR No. 27/2021 u/s 498A/323/341/506 IPC registered at PS Greater Kailash.
The parties state that they are staying together and living happily with each other.
The affidavit of respondent No. 2 is on record.
There is one minor child born out of the wedlock.
The petitioner is present is Court and is identified by Mr. Harsh Jaidka, Adv.
Respondent No. 2 is also present and is identified by Mr. Manoj Kumar, Adv. and Insp. Anil Kumar, PS Greater Kailash-1.
The parties state that they have arrived at the settlement out of their own free will, without any threat, pressure, coercion or undue influence.
Respondent No. 2 states that she has no objection if the FIR is quashed.
In view of the aforesaid, FIR No. 27/2021 u/s 498A/323/341/506 IPC registered at PS Greater Kailash, is hereby quashed.
